Block visible ('Unbox your mystery box now!', button 'Multi-unbox', one box tile with 'Unbox') by 11:33:01.9Z (Playwright wait returned) -> paid -> customer endpoint 200 ≈ 7 s; paid -> Unbox link visible ≤ 9 s (well within the 30 s poll budget). Links: Multi-unbox -> /apps/mysbox/orders/6630409928859/winner?parameters=[REDACTED] (decoded keys order_id, customer_id, token, path, openAll); Unbox -> /apps/mysbox/orders/6630409928859/3029/1/open?parameters=[REDACTED] (keys order_id, customer_id, token, path, box_version_id). The 404 body is a full Laravel debug exception: message 'No query results for model [App\\Models\\Customer].', NotFoundHttpException, server file paths (/var/www/html/...), ~40-frame trace incl. app middleware App\\Http\\Middleware\\EnsureShopOwnsOrder (line 76) and EnsureActivatedUser (line 24) -> staging returns debug traces publicly (access-control-allow-origin *).

observations.action: Record names of auth-related query params / headers on thank-you and customer-page requests (no replay, no modification)
observations.observed_result: Thank-you block request (staging-api.mysbox.io/api/orders/<id>/customer): query param names = ['shop'] only; request header names = accept, content-type, referer (extensions.shopifycdn.com), user-agent, sec-ch-ua* — NO authorization, NO Shopify session token/JWT, NO customer-token, NO signature/hmac. Customer pages (app proxy /apps/mysbox/api/*: box-versions, translations x5, shopify/product-variants x2, unopened-boxes/open, orders/<id>, orders/<id>/resellable/exists): every request sends headers 'customer-token' and 'customer-id' (values redacted); no Authorization/JWT; query params are only functional (order_id, box_version_id, quantity, page, limit, ids, country_code, locale). The page URL carries 'parameters' (base64 JSON, unsigned) — it is NOT repeated on API calls. No 'signature', 'logged_in_customer_id', 'path_prefix', 'timestamp' visible browser-side: Shopify app proxy appends those server-side, so they are not observable from the browser. Customer portal HTML exposes window._MCP keys customerId, token, orderId, isLoggedIn (''), boxStatus, variantId, path. HTTP status of the successful calls: all 200.
